heroSummary: The Bambu Lab A1 Mini handles eSUN PLA+ exceptionally well out of the box with its stock stainless steel nozzle and open-bed architecture. Given its 22 mm³/s volumetric flow limit, it reliably sustains print speeds up to 262 mm/s at standard 0.2mm layer heights without requiring any hardware upgrades.
bedSurfaceRecommendation: Textured PEI Plate (clean with warm water and dish soap, no adhesive required)
slicerTweaks: Set Max Volumetric Speed to 22 mm³/s in the filament profile to cap print speed automatically at 262 mm/s on standard layer geometry.
Tune Pressure Advance (PA) in OrcaSlicer to approximately 0.024–0.028 to eliminate corner swelling at high travel accelerations.
Configure nozzle temperature to 215°C for normal layers and 220°C for the initial layer to maximize early bed adhesion.
Enable 'Wipe while retracting' with a 1.0mm wipe distance to mitigate fine stringing characteristic of modified PLA impact additives.

troubleshootingMatrix.issue: Stringing and fine wisps across open travel moves
troubleshootingMatrix.rootCause: PLA+ modifiers increase melt elasticity, combined with excessive nozzle temperature or disabled retraction z-hop.
troubleshootingMatrix.exactFix: Reduce nozzle temperature from 220°C to 210°C and ensure retraction distance is set to 0.8mm with spiral z-hop enabled.

troubleshootingMatrix.issue: Under-extrusion or matte banding on high-speed infill
troubleshootingMatrix.rootCause: Volumetric flow rate exceeding the melt capacity of the stock stainless steel hotend past 22 mm³/s.
troubleshootingMatrix.exactFix: Hard cap Max Volumetric Speed at 20–22 mm³/s in OrcaSlicer filament settings to prevent flow starvation.

troubleshootingMatrix.issue: First layer edge peeling or corner warping
troubleshootingMatrix.rootCause: PEI plate contaminated with skin oils or bed temperature set too low for eSUN PLA+.
troubleshootingMatrix.exactFix: Scrub the textured PEI sheet with dish soap and set heated bed temperature to 60°C.

faq.question: Does eSUN PLA+ require a hardened steel nozzle on the A1 Mini?
faq.answer: No, eSUN PLA+ is a non-abrasive modified PLA, meaning the stock 0.4mm stainless steel nozzle handles it without premature wear.

faq.question: Can I print eSUN PLA+ inside an enclosure on the Bambu A1 Mini?
faq.answer: No, printing PLA+ inside an enclosure often leads to heat creep and cold-end clogging due to low glass transition temperatures; the open-frame A1 Mini is ideal.

faq.question: Why is eSUN PLA+ printed hotter than standard PLA?
faq.answer: PLA+ incorporates impact modifiers and elastomeric tougheners that increase melt viscosity, requiring 210°C–220°C for optimal layer bonding and high-speed flow.

faq.question: Do I need to dry eSUN PLA+ before printing on the A1 Mini?
faq.answer: While standard PLA is minimally hygroscopic, wet PLA+ can cause stringing and popping; if unsealed for weeks, dry at 45°C for 4–6 hours.
